import pysam,json,collections
fa=pysam.FastaFile('reference/chr9.hg38.fa')
comp=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')
code=dict(zip((a+b+c for a in 'TCAG' for b in 'TCAG' for c in 'TCAG'),'FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG'))
sites=collections.defaultdict(list)
valid=invalid=0
for line in open('reference/refGene.chr9.hg38.txt'):
 t=line.strip().split('\\t'); name,chrom,strand=t[1:4]; start,end=map(int,t[6:8]); gene=t[12]
 if t[13]"'!='"'cmpl': continue
 positions=[]
 for a,b in zip(map(int,t[9].strip(',').split(',')),map(int,t[10].strip(',').split(','))):
  positions.extend(range(max(a,start),min(b,end)))
 seq=''.join(fa.fetch(chrom,a,b) for a,b in zip(map(int,t[9].strip(',').split(',')),map(int,t[10].strip(',').split(','))) if False)
 seq=''.join(fa.fetch(chrom,max(a,start),min(b,end)) for a,b in zip(map(int,t[9].strip(',').split(',')),map(int,t[10].strip(',').split(','))) if max(a,start)<min(b,end))
 if strand=='-': positions=positions[::-1];seq=seq.translate(comp)[::-1]
 if len(seq)%3 or seq[:3]"'!='"'ATG': invalid+=1;continue
 valid+=1
 for i in range(0,len(seq)-3,3):
  codon=seq[i:i+3]
  if codon not in code or code[codon]=='*':continue
  for j in range(3):
   for alt in 'ACGT':
    mut=codon[:j]+alt+codon[j+1:]
    if alt==codon[j] or code.get(mut)"'!='"'*':continue
    pos=positions[i+j];ref=codon[j];ga=alt
    if strand=='-':ref=ref.translate(comp);ga=ga.translate(comp)
    key=f'{pos+1}:{ref}:{ga}'
    sites[key].append([gene,name,strand,f'{code[codon]}{i//3+1}*',codon,mut])
json.dump(sites,open('work/stop_sites.json','w'))
positions=sorted({int(k.split(':')[0])-1 for k in sites})
with open('work/stop_sites.bed','w') as f:
 for p in positions:f.write(f'chr9\\t{p}\\t{p+1}\\n')
print('valid transcripts',valid,'invalid',invalid,'possible nonsense alleles',len(sites),'positions',len(positions))
PY
python3 work/make_stop_sites.py"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > work/screen_stops.py <<'PY'
import csv,gzip,json
sites=json.load(open('work/stop_sites.json'))
constraint={r['gene']:r for r in csv.DictReader(gzip.open('reference/gnomad.v2.1.1.lof_metrics.by_gene.txt.bgz','rt'),delimiter='\\t')}
out=open('work/nonsense_candidates.tsv','w')
header=['chrom','pos','ref','alt','dp','ref_count','alt_count','af','alt_forward','alt_reverse','gene','pLI','oe_lof_upper','transcripts']
print('\\t'.join(header),file=out)
for l in open('work/stop_pileup.tsv'):
 chrom,pos,ref,alts,dp,ads,adfs,adrs=l.strip().split('\\t')
 dp=int(dp);ad=list(map(int,ads.split(',')));adf=list(map(int,adfs.split(',')));adr=list(map(int,adrs.split(',')))
 for n,alt in enumerate(alts.split(','),1):
  key=f'{pos}:{ref}:{alt}'; total=sum(ad)
  if key not in sites or ad[n]<3 or total<8 or ad[n]/total<.04:continue
  annotations=sites[key];genes=sorted({a[0] for a in annotations})
  for gene in genes:
   c=constraint.get(gene,{})
   vals=[chrom,pos,ref,alt,dp,ad[0],ad[n],round(ad[n]/total,4),adf[n],adr[n],gene,c.get('pLI','NA'),c.get('oe_lof_upper','NA'),';'.join(a[1]+':'+a[3] for a in annotations if a[0]==gene)]
   line='\\t'.join(map(str,vals));print(line,file=out);print(line)
PY

import pysam,collections,json
b=pysam.AlignmentFile('work/aligned.hg38.bam');f=pysam.FastaFile('reference/chr9.hg38.fa');p=127661125
print('Reference context:',f.fetch('chr9',p-21,p+20))
for mq,bq in [(20,20),(30,25),(40,30),(60,30)]:
 counts=collections.Counter(); strands=collections.Counter();starts=collections.defaultdict(set);qpos=collections.defaultdict(list);qual=collections.defaultdict(list);edit=collections.defaultdict(list);reads=[]
 for col in b.pileup('chr9',p-1,p,truncate=True,min_mapping_quality=mq,min_base_quality=bq,stepper='samtools',max_depth=100000,compute_baq=False):
  for pr in col.pileups:
   if pr.is_del or pr.is_refskip:continue
   r=pr.alignment;i=pr.query_position;a=r.query_sequence[i]
   counts[a]+=1;strands[(a,'-' if r.is_reverse else '+')]+=1;starts[a].add((r.reference_start,r.is_reverse));qpos[a].append(i);qual[a].append(r.query_qualities[i]);edit[a].append(r.get_tag('NM'))
   if a=='T':reads.append({'read':r.query_name,'start':r.reference_start+1,'strand':'-' if r.is_reverse else '+','mapq':r.mapping_quality,'baseq':r.query_qualities[i],'read_pos':i+1,'cigar':r.cigarstring,'edit_distance':r.get_tag('NM'),'local_seq':r.query_sequence[max(0,i-6):i+7]})
 print('MQ,BQ',mq,bq,'counts',dict(counts),'strands',dict(strands),'unique_starts',{a:len(x) for a,x in starts.items()})
 if mq==30:
  print('Alternate read details:',json.dumps(reads,indent=2))
  json.dump(reads,open('work/STXBP1_alt_reads.json','w'),indent=2)
PY
python3 work/validate_candidate.py"
